title: Day 20: Choosing a Listing Agent – Questions Sellers Should Ask
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “best listing agent Austin”, “how to choose realtor to sell my house”, and “questions to ask real estate agent Austin” want a local, practical answer.

Interview more than one agent. Ask for recent sold comps in your specific price band and neighborhood, their average days on market versus the market average, marketing plan beyond the MLS, and communication style.

Track record in your micro-market matters more than overall volume.

Discuss compensation structure and seller concessions strategy up front.

Chemistry and clear communication reduce stress during the 30–60 day listing period and the subsequent under-contract phase.

If you are weighing a list date, a price, or a repair list, The Banks Group will run the numbers for your street and help you decide. Start with a complimentary conversation.
